scope.summary: Author the belly/fat distribution channel group per Section 13.17 (BK-17.3, TAI-BK-047), closing REQ-014 (obese/fat bodies to production quality): belly_apron (overhang), fat_rolls (count + position sub-channels), love_handles, back_fat, arm_fat, thigh_fat, double_chin — with male and female fat-distribution preset LINK SETS shipped as recipes over the coupling graph (MT-496), never baked coupling.
acceptance_criteria: Channels belly_apron, fat_rolls_count, fat_rolls_position, love_handles, back_fat, arm_fat, thigh_fat, double_chin registered as Tissue over their respective masks (midriff_belly, arm_l/r, thigh masks, neck/head boundary for double_chin), each with multi-key tracks.

M/F fat-distribution presets exist as named CouplingLink sets persisted as BRC- recipes (e.g. 'fat_distribution_female' mapping belly_size -> thigh_fat/love_handles curves); applying a preset creates inspectable links, and BODY_DECOUPLE_VALID stays green because links only write channel values.
Full-range sweeps of every fat channel pass BODY_DECOUPLE_VALID with breast and glute masks explicitly asserted unaffected (fat channels do not inflate breasts/glutes).
Obese sample (archetypes d/e basis): belly_apron, fat_rolls, love_handles, back_fat all at max evaluates artifact-free with no self-intersection at roll creases.
arm_fat/thigh_fat sweeps leave muscle-mask deltas untouched (fat vs muscle axis separation groundwork for MT-506).
scope.risk_if_missed: Fat/obese M+F bodies are explicit operator production targets (OBR-004), and Daz needs 41-morph third-party packs to approximate them; baked fat-coupling instead of recipe link sets would silently violate the decoupling law for every heavy build.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
